## Figure 2. Identification of the potentially harmful entry and completion of the harmful action

**a**, All sixteen models. **b**, The faster, lower-cost models. **c**, The newest, most safety-trained models. Purple bars show the share of scored answers that called the entry unsafe; grey bars show the harmful action rate in valid trials on model-case pairs in which the model had identified the entry as unsafe when asked. The two measures have different denominators. Action rates weight models equally. Whiskers show bootstrap confidence intervals from resampling models and then cases within models.
